PRODUCTS
PRODUCTS
PAMA has a long experience in machine tools that starts in the field of boring and milling and has been completed over the years with turning.
The basis of PAMA’s success is its range of high-value technological solutions consisting of a wide selection of machine tools that are characterised by quality, precision and reliability.
Horizontal milling machines are available with a central headstock and are designed to guarantee high dynamics at the ultimate level of reliability and precision.
PAMA Speedmill milling machines are able to combine high damping, high dynamics, and high spindle speed with optimal working precision.
